title: Arizona v. Gant (2009)
key_points: Holding: Police may search a vehicle incident to a recent occupant's arrest only if the arrestee is unsecured and within reach of the passenger area, or it is reasonable to believe evidence of the arrest offense is in the vehicle.
officer_notes: Scenario: You arrest a driver for driving while suspended, handcuff him and place him in your car.
Takeaway: A secured arrestee for a suspended license usually means no search incident to arrest of the car.
